family.description: This protein family includes Protein YebY from Escherichia coli and similar proteins predominantly found in Gammaproteobacteria. YebY is a component of the AZY copper uptake system, where it functions as a negative regulator of the copper importer YebZ [[cite:PUB00163268]]. At high copper concentrations, YebY may act as a safety valve, preventing toxic copper overload by inhibiting the import activity of YebZ and YobA [[cite:PUB00163268]]. The reduced form of YebY binds Cu(+) and Cu(2+) with low affinity and shows low specificity, also binding Co(2+), Ni(2+), and Ag(+) [[cite:PUB00100157]]. However, the low affinity of copper binding, together with the stabilisation imparted by a disulphide bond, suggests that this metal binding is likely not physiologically relevant [[cite:PUB00100157]].
family.name: Protein YebY
